name: Device value changes
description: Starts when a device value changes: to or from a value, above or below a threshold, optionally only after it has stayed there for a time.

device_id.description: The device the property belongs to.

channel_id.description: The channel the property belongs to.

to.description: Start when the value becomes this.

from.description: Start only when the value was this before the change.

above.description: Start when a numeric value rises above this.

below.description: Start when a numeric value falls below this.

hysteresis.description: How far the value has to come back before the threshold can start a run again.

for_seconds.description: Start only after the value has stayed in the target state this long. Needs "to", "above" or "below".

name: Device value is
description: Continues on "yes" when a device value compares as asked, and on "no" when it does not or when the value is not known.

device_id.description: The device the property belongs to.

channel_id.description: The channel the property belongs to.

operator.description: How to compare. Which operators are offered depends on what the property holds.

value.description: The value to compare with; for every operator but "between" and "in".

name: Set device value
description: Sets one or more device values. Values of the same device are applied together.

writes.description: The values to set. Values of the same device are applied together.

device_id.description: The device the property belongs to.

channel_id.description: The channel the property belongs to.

name: Delay
description: Waits for a time, at most one hour, and then continues.

name: Manual start
description: Starts only when the automation is run by hand.

name: Send notification
description: Raises a notification with a severity, a title and an optional message.

message.description: Plain text; new lines are kept.

name: Run scene
description: Runs a scene and waits until it has finished.

name: Time of day
description: Starts at a time of day, on every day or on chosen weekdays, in the house timezone.

time.description: The time, HH:mm on the 24-hour house clock.

weekdays.description: The days to start on: 0 is Sunday, 6 is Saturday. Left out means every day.

name: Time is between
description: Continues on "yes" while the house clock is inside a time window, on every day or on chosen weekdays. The window may cross midnight.

from.description: Start of the window, HH:mm, included.

to.description: End of the window, HH:mm, not included. Earlier than the start for a window over midnight.

weekdays.description: The days the window starts on: 0 is Sunday, 6 is Saturday. Left out means every day.
